people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Therefore thus I will do to you, Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.
translations.bsb: “Therefore, that is what I will do to you, O Israel, and since I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel!
translations.kjv: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
translations.asv: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel; and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
